Alright, now that th...
items.summary:
Gosh I love malformed toes. 

Alright, now that the hook is out of the way I will start with my review.

I'm not going to sugarcoat it, I enjoyed the game when I started it however recently it's gone really downhill. There are a lot of good things about it, and if you started playing the game recently there is a lot to enjoy. 

However very recently, the game has gone downhill and it's not going to change if people defend BIAV's decisions and continue without acknowledging the massive flaws in the game, BIAV will keep testing people's goodwill. I can not recommend the game, because BIAV needs to know that people are angry with their decisions. And 100 free pulls won't fix that (ethereal cores, a whole other topic)

When I first started out the game was extremely awesome and niche (this was around a half annivesary just before they released Doresain). The devs would frequently talk about how the game was close to EOS and it really made them out to be very transparent and wholesome developers. I spent money and I'm happy I did, because in my mind the devs were one of the coolest and most open devs for a gacha game I ever saw. And I wanted to support morimens cause I believed in it. They stopped using Chat-GPT translations and hired real translators, they have been very generous with pull currency and all in all the vibe of the game was absoultely my cup of tea. 

Arc 1 was extremely memorable, with great characters, banter, lore and all around the story felt satisfying and had a good overall plot and ending. The gameplay was also fantastic but there are game modes I really don't like, however that's for later in the review, there are also some gripes I had with Arc 2 and recent stories.

The gameplay is awesome, you got vulnerable and weaken (which have recently been RARE in characters). Each character had some really unique gimmicks and cards that determined your deck you were going to use. And the difficulty was just right, but they allowed respawns and infinite retries which was awesome. If you faced a difficult fight there was always a chance you could win if you find the right move, and dude death resistance (like death's door from darkest dungeon) made some fights heart dropping and intense. No other gacha game I played ever gave me the same feeling.

Despite the good things I mentinoed, they've recently been pushing my goodwill and faith in them. At first I thought I got burntout and to an extent it's true. However there's been ALOT of times the developers had lied and changed the original game to fall in line with another server (their recent JP release) where instead of importing the global version they made another version of Morimens that they "balanced" by dialing back characters and pushed for harder monetization. 

This involved significantly changing realms (in this game they determine what systems you interact with, using Slay The Spire as an example, these change up your gameplay like how defect has orbs, ironclad heals) to divine realms. While sure in theory they are cool, they absolutely screw over some characters, and with every new character being divine realm and not a toggle it has soured my use of certain characters (Horla, Sorel) and trust in new characters. 
Unlike switching the rules from Arc 1 to Arc 2 I think divine realms are an awful addition. And essentially change how CHARACTERS YOU PREVIOUSLY PAID FOR work and in turn how you play the game, rather then something you adjust to. Arc 2 I didn't mind cause the core was there, but divine realm DRASTICALLY changes how characters work, some are regular realm and some are divine realm. New WODS (genshin weapons) are bottlenecked with 3 turn cooldowns and do absolutely nothing for 3 turns unlike some WOD's that do stuff every turn (a hallmark of the divine realm is 3 turn cooldowns for every interaction with the realm mechanic). And I hate seeing this (devs please put a cooldown on the WOD's I can see, cause holy hell is it awful to track WOD effects without some form of indicator). The core issue is that this was introduced after 2 years and is an extremely awful change now that the devs have confirmed that all characters are divine realm going forward.

Now characters require more alimeus (basically like your energy in genshin to use ults) to random numbers for ults I don't think in theory should be increased, originally every character needed 100 ailemus but now some require 200 and 150 instead. Which sours the experience even more, while I understand for some, some others I don't understand why (caroboo).

There's alot of things recently that made the experience even worse they made d-tide a spiral abyss type mode even more hp inflated and difficult. As well as locking premium currency behind clearing difficult stages (and by difficult I mean DIFFICULT). Despite being perfectly fine beforehand.

They made ethereal cores which disappear after 100 days, they promised it would be given more often but I barely noticed any difference in giving pulls. I don't hate it but it just doesn't sit right with me.

They made the convenant system (artifacts from genshin) more in line with genshin. Originally you could have one set split between all characters. But now they want you to have a unique set for each character to get 50% more stats. And I absolutely hate it cause I can tell it's out of greed, and they are totally going to balance the game around it. When you didn't bind convenants it meant more freedom in how you play characters and what you equip, if you wanted a specific set on someone you can just give it to them,  but now BIAV decided NO can't have that we NEED a Genshin, HSR, CZN, WUWA form of artifact system.

They made +12 (dupes) for characters absolutely insane, and then dropped them ALL at the same patch (like 3 patches ago) the devs said THEY WOULDN'T drop all of them at the same time OR balance the game around AA but they showed they can't be trusted and did EXACTLY that (read d-tide). 

I won't comment on the story, but Arc 2 has currently not hit as hard as Arc 1. That is all I will say, the story is better than a majority of other gacha stories but the story as it is right now has lost a lot of the soul of the original arc 1 chapters (for me at least).

I don't like the additional modes, and while some may enjoy them I personally don't. I really hate Traphase (their PVP mode) and I wish there was a PVE traphase but that defeats the point, but they are very aggressive about it. They haven't released a traphase event THANK GOD but this mode is not for me and I despise how hard it is shilled, and takes up a good chunk of patch notes.

I don't like their Slay the Spire esque mode Hectic Skybound Rail. The gamemode doesn't really introduce new cards, and they reuse mechanics that existed in Arc 1, but with Arc 2 rules. For me personally it gets stale. When they released this I almost left the game, it was around Vortice's release. It was disappointing.

P-dive is ok. I think it gets tedious after a while however some people like it and that's ok.

All in all I've been extremely disappointed with the game so far. It now no longer resembles the original game I loved. While it's partially because of burnout, a majority of my exhaustion comes from not liking the direction the game has taken, I will not longer offer them any money going forward and I've said my piece about what I dislike about the game. Will I still play it? Yes but it's no longer a game I play regularly and it's just lost the soul that made me stick with the game originally. Light I don't trust you anymore, and while I appreciate that you have been extremely vocal, you are clearly just another gacha dev in the space like evey other gacha dev. And I'm sad that you allowed the game to no longer be the game that I believed in. I hope the game succeeds, but if you get close to EOS'ing again don't expect the community to side with you like they did before. Or if people do, don't expect me to be one of them.

items.title: [正面] Fico imaginando como seria Morimens se tivesse uma...
items.summary:
Fico imaginando como seria Morimens se tivesse uma exploração em 2D ou 3D conosco movendo o grupo como em um RPG ao estilo de Valkirie Profile, e é só isso que falta pro jogo ser 10/10, já que o estilo de exploração em "tabuleiro" me incomoda um pouco.

As batalhas são incriveis e o formato de construção de deck também é muito interessante.

O enredo é muito bom, beirando a excelência. Só não é perfeito porque falta localizar o jogo para o Português Brasileiro corrigindo alguns erros bem estranhos de tradução automatica.

No geral 7/10
Vale a pena jogar e experimentar
